name: extreme_ratio
src: 本节概述系统的总体架构，包括数据采集、预处理、特征提取、模型训练、在线推理和监控告警六个部分。
tgt: This section gives an overview of the system architecture.
Feature extraction and model training are described next.
Online inference is introduced after that.
Finally, monitoring and alerting are discussed.
notes: 1:6 extreme ratio; human annotation is bulk-uncertain, system must flag, not force a confident pairing.
